text: DBIM IMPORTANT LINKS CARRY THE HOME SECTIONS DBIM HAS NO PLACE FOR. The New and Classic home pages show sections the DBIM 3.0 home composition does not — Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan's pledge and volunteer calls, Find a De-addiction Centre, and the SAMAVESH band. Their actions now lead Important Links, so the DBIM home page's four rows are Nasha Mukt Bharat e-Pledge, Become a Nasha Mukti Mitr, Find a De-addiction Centre and SAMAVESH Services Gateway, each opening its portal page in a new tab; the divisions and the Social Audit MIS Portal follow on the Important Links page. Activity Corner and Need Support? are not repeated: DBIM already has them as Connect › Events and Connect › Contact Us.
